summary: This is an array of objects that maps articles to related articles. Each object specifies a source article and lists other articles that are relevant to it, creating a cross-reference system for documentation or knowledge base navigation.

explanations.4: An empty array means no related articles have been suggested for this Docker introduction piece yet.
explanations.8: This array contains one suggested link, meaning the local LLMs article should reference the Ollama getting-started guide.
explanations.16: This creates a bidirectional reference: the Ollama article links back to the local LLMs article, so readers can navigate between these related topics in both directions.
